policy.not_refittable: Available observations or source reduction/calibration details are insufficient for an independent full refit. A qualified subset or proxy calculation may still be available as a diagnostic.
policy.parity: Every fitted parameter agrees within combined 2-sigma and also meets the parameter-specific numerical similarity threshold. The Sakai 2018 rhenium audit explicitly accepts numerical parity within reported parameter error widths, with comparable refit standard errors; its source confidence convention remains unknown. Sakai 2011 NaCl-B2 parity is conditional fixed-V0 agreement within printed error widths, without claiming the unspecified source weights, marker averaging or error confidence were recovered. Fei 2007 Au parity is a staged equal-pressure-weight replay within printed parameter widths; source weights, exact MgO reduction and error confidence/covariance remain unresolved. For explicitly registered Peritheos refits, parity verifies the stored coefficients under the documented selection and objective; it does not imply reproduction of source-author coefficients. Diopside parity is conditional agreement within reported error widths, including a graph-corroborated corrected Zhao analysis dataset; exact original inputs and workflow remain unrecovered. Sakai 2025 Au parity concerns only the independently fitted K0-prime central value at published precision under stated calibrants and residuals, not uncertainty or sequential-network parity. Phase E (Crichton and Ross 2000) achieves fit parity within reported parameter error widths, with small pressure-curve differences relative to the observation errors. Exact author workflow availability is a separate provenance assessment. Katsura 2022 forsterite accepts conditional numerical parity within printed Table 2 parameter error widths. The full-precision theta0=760 K author-script vector is recommended; the theta0=768 K table alternative is retained. Table errors are a comparison scale only for the script vector; script-specific errors, covariance and exact bootstrap reproduction remain unavailable. Dewaele 2008 Table IV parity compares free coefficients with printed 95% parameter widths under the documented fixed constraints. Table VI parity has source-equation scope only: identified Figure 4 checkpoints pass declared reading and printed-coefficient bounds. It is not PAW refit or author-workflow reproduction; the four unresolved Fe LDA sets are excluded.
policy.parity_not_achieved: At least one fitted parameter is outside both the uncertainty and similarity criteria, or a dedicated partial-source audit cannot reproduce the published coefficient pair.
policy.similar: Every fitted parameter either agrees within combined 2-sigma or meets the documented parameter-specific similarity threshold.
policy.source_reconstruction: A source calculation or composition of audited source equations is reproduced without independently fitting the complete EOS coefficients. Component refits and remaining source-input gaps are documented separately.
